data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A–stage defense and security company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers operating in the Defense & Security sector.

The peer-median approach forms the primary valuation anchor. Three same-sector, same-stage peers—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yield a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This wide dispersion reflects material differences in technology maturity, customer traction, or strategic positioning within the defense robotics space. The median of $400M implies Greenroom at this point in the capital stack.

The triangulated range stands at $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single valuation method applied to a limited peer set. Key uncertainties include the extent of Greenroom's differentiation within the comparable set, product commercialization progress relative to peers, and customer pipeline visibility. The wide dispersion in the raw peer data ($125M to $4.0B) suggests material unobserved heterogeneity; reconciling where Greenroom positions within that range requires granular assessment of technology readiness, go-to-market execution, and defensibility relative to Anduril, Helsing, and other leading private competitors.
